title: Private Edge operator onboarding & launch coordination (RBAC, Audit Streams, KMS)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: Coordinate a cross-functional launch playbook for Private Edge deployments that include RBAC, continuous audit-streaming to customer destinations, and integrated KMS key rotation flows. This ticket owns the operator onboarding checklist, the release-note bundle for customer comms, and the internal runbook for SRE/Support.

Scope: - RBAC policy templates and example mappings for operator roles (Operator, Auditor, Sysadmin)
- Audit log streaming options and validation checks (S3, GCS, SIEM webhook)
- KMS integration docs and key rotation checklist (Cloud KMS, customer HSM)
- Go-to-market assets: release notes, customer enablement checklist, support runbooks, training session plan

Out of scope: pricing/legal contracting changes, deep platform kernel/runtime work (those are separate ENG tickets).
goals:
1) Ensure a smooth customer onboarding path for Private Edge customers with clear RBAC templates and audit-collection verification steps.
2) Ship release notes and enablement materials aligned with enterprise compliance requirements.
3) Provide SRE and Support with a reproducible runbook and troubleshooting playbook covering key failure modes.
acceptance_criteria:
- RBAC templates published to Confluence and included in CLI/Docker installer examples.
- Audit-stream test harness available and validated end-to-end against S3 and a SIEM webhook in staging.
- KMS rotation steps documented and an automated smoke test added to the private CI pipeline.
- Release notes draft approved by Legal and Security and published to the docs site.
- Support runbook reviewed by SRE and one knowledge-transfer session completed.
launch_plan_summary:
Phase 1: Internal alpha + SRE validation (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Customer beta with 3 early adopters (canary cohort) + monitoring (3 weeks)
Phase 3: General availability with coordinated release notes, SDK updates, and training (1 week)
Rolling policy: start with single-region operator installs, then enable multi-region after monitoring is stable.

risk_mitigation:
Risk: Audit streaming throughput spikes could expose latency to hosted workloads.
Mitigation: Add synthetic load tests (ENG-30112) and rate-limiting knobs; include fallback to buffered S3 delivery.

Risk: KMS rotation complexity for customer HSMs.
Mitigation: Provide a documented manual fall-back and sample scripts; require Security signoff prior to GA.

Risk: RBAC template mismatch with customer orgs.
Mitigation: Provide a mapping worksheet and two sample enterprise mappings; schedule a 1:1 onboarding call for beta customers.
release_notes_draft:
Highlights:
- Private Edge: Operator RBAC templates for common roles (Operator, Auditor, Admin)
- Audit Streams: Streaming to customer destinations (S3/GCS/SIEM webhook) with validation checks
- KMS Integration: Key rotation guide and automated CI smoke test for rotation flow
What customers need to do:
1) Review RBAC templates and adapt group mappings.
2) Configure audit destination and run the validation tool included in the installer.
3) Confirm KMS provider and test rotation in staging.
Known limitations:
- SIEM webhook supports basic auth + TLS; advanced auth providers coming in next release.
- Multi-region operator installs are beta.

notes:
Design decision summary: we chose templated RBAC + mapping guide instead of an opinionated role engine to reduce churn and speed onboarding. Trade-off: slightly more manual for customers but much faster to document and support.

Review feedback: Security wants explicit rotation verification steps; Support wants sample curl-based verification commands added to the runbook.
communication_plan:

- Customers: Beta invites to 3 existing customers with recommended contact points.
- Public: Docs site release notes + changelog entry; email to enterprise admin contacts on GA day.
privacy_and_compliance: Retention guidance and opt-in patterns documented; Priya Reddy to confirm GDPR transfer language. Audit logs default to customer-controlled destinations; Redwood will not store customer audit contents by default.
customer_onboarding_notes: Provide a pre-flight checklist for customers that includes: network egress rules, KMS credentials (or HSM contact), RBAC mapping worksheet, and sample audit destination. Offer a 90-min onboarding call for beta customers.
